notes.title: Temple of Causality is now streamer friendly!
notes.content: We observed that recently a a lot of streamers started playing the game on YouTube and were receiving copyright claims from the songs we used in the game. While we do own rights for commercial usage but that license does not get extended to the streamers. Thereby, taking a note of the same we have now removed all songs that could lead to copyright claims on streamers and therefore making the game streamer friendly! ːsteamthumbsupː
